Frictionless Bargaining

How Haggle Works

Traditional marketplaces fix prices. Haggle brings back the art of negotiation, backed by rigorous server-side safety and instant checkout.

01

Pick Your Artisan Item

Browse limited-run handcrafted goods listed directly by artisan makers. Review the public asking price, inventory status, and pre-approved seller concessions.

Verified Stock & Seller Profiles
02

Chat or Voice Bargain with AI

Make your offer using keyboard or Chrome voice dictation. The seller's Claude agent evaluates your offer, counters intelligently, and trades pre-approved perks like free shipping or care kits.

Natural Voice & Text Engine
03

Lock for 15m & Pay via PayPal

When buyer and AI reach consensus, the agreed price locks for exactly 15 minutes with a live countdown. Check out smoothly via PayPal sandbox or debit/credit card with zero forced account creation.

15-Minute Guaranteed Lock
Security & Integrity Invariants

Mathematical Floor Isolation & Zero Compromises

Haggle is architected with strict financial controls. Sensitive business rules are guarded by deterministic code before any LLM inference occurs.

Secret Floor Isolation

Floor prices reside exclusively in database storage. Never transmitted to buyer browsers, API payloads, or Claude system prompts.

Server-Enforced 15m Expiry

Expired deals cannot be paid. Both order creation and capture endpoints return HTTP 410 on stale timestamps.

Server Price Retrieval

PayPal order creation retrieves amount strictly from server-side Deal records, ignoring any client-injected amounts.

Atomic Stock Decrement

Inventory decrements atomically inside Prisma transactions only upon verified PayPal capture. Zero over-selling risk.
